cases.prompt: The plan for adding a Kalman filter to our sensor fusion package is approved: three phases, each listing its tests first and its automated checks. Execute it phase by phase on a feature branch, ticking off tasks, and pause after each phase so I can verify manually.
Phases 1 and 2 of our regridding plan are checked off. Pick up at phase 3 and keep building until its automated verification passes, flagging anywhere the code doesn't match what the plan expected.
Halfway through building the Kalman filter we found the sensor timestamps aren't monotonic. Before writing any more code, change the plan to add a phase for timestamp repair.
A teammate says the Kalman filter plan is fully implemented and all 45 tests are green. Check it independently against the plan before we merge.
